## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Related Issue

Link the issue when one exists.

## Validation

List the automated tests, focused checks, and any manual validation performed. State limitations precisely.

## Privacy, Safety, and Compatibility Checklist

- [ ] I used only project-created fictional data that does not describe a real person.
- [ ] This change contains no PHI, PII, credentials, private correspondence, databases, reports, workbooks, exports, logs, screenshots, release archives, executables, or other generated artifacts.
- [ ] I considered local-first behavior, data storage, generated outputs, and backward compatibility; effects are explained above or are not applicable.
- [ ] I did not broaden Len into medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, crisis support, or emergency functionality.
- [ ] I added or updated automated tests when business logic changed, or explained why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation, including an iteration record for a substantial change, or explained why documentation is not applicable.
- [ ] I ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and `git diff --check`, or identified the checks I could not run.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI assistance and reviewed the resulting work for correctness, licensing, provenance, privacy, and security.

## Migration and Release Impact

Describe any user-data migration, storage-location change, packaging effect, or release consideration. Write `None` when there is no impact.
